# Programming / SQL

Write, check, explain, optimise, debug and translate SQL across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle and SQLite, plus analytics, reporting and data-quality work.

| Skill | What it does | Scripts |
|-------|--------------|---------|
| [sql-analytics](sql-analytics/SKILL.md) | Analytical and aggregation SQL — GROUP BY, ROLLUP, CUBE, GROUPING SETS, pivots, cohorts, funnels, retention, percentiles and statistical functions. | `analytics_sql.py` |
| [sql-data-quality](sql-data-quality/SKILL.md) | Profile and validate data with SQL — NULL analysis, duplicate detection, referential integrity, range and format checks, outliers, constraints and cleansing queries. | `profile_data.py` |
| [sql-debugger](sql-debugger/SKILL.md) | Debug failing SQL or queries returning wrong results — interpret error messages, find causes of duplicates, missing rows, NULL surprises, fan-out joins and type mismatches, and produce a fixed query. | `diagnose_error.py` |
| [sql-dialect-translator](sql-dialect-translator/SKILL.md) | Translate SQL between dialects — PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server (T-SQL), Oracle, SQLite — covering data types, functions, pagination, date handling, upserts and identity columns. | `translate_sql.py` |
| [sql-optimizer](sql-optimizer/SKILL.md) | Rewrite slow SQL queries for performance — read execution plans (EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE), remove anti-patterns, make predicates sargable, choose JOIN/EXISTS strategies and suggest indexes. | `find_antipatterns.py` |
| [sql-performance-tuning](sql-performance-tuning/SKILL.md) | Database-level SQL performance tuning — index design and maintenance, query profiling, statistics, partitioning, schema design, locking and configuration bottlenecks. | `analyze_plan.py` |
| [sql-query-explainer](sql-query-explainer/SKILL.md) | Explain what an existing SQL query does in plain language — logical execution order, step-by-step breakdown of joins, filters, grouping and window logic, and the shape of the result. | `outline_query.py` |
| [sql-query-writer](sql-query-writer/SKILL.md) | Write correct, readable SQL from natural-language requirements — SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, JOINs, subqueries, CTEs and DDL (CREATE/ALTER/DROP). | `plan_joins.py` |
| [sql-reporting](sql-reporting/SKILL.md) | Build business reporting SQL — KPIs, dashboard datasets, period comparisons (MoM/YoY), executive, sales and financial reports and scheduled-report queries. | `date_ranges.py` |
| [sql-syntax-checker](sql-syntax-checker/SKILL.md) | Validate SQL syntax and structure before execution and point out errors with corrected versions, dialect-aware (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite). | `check_sql.py` |
| [sql-window-functions](sql-window-functions/SKILL.md) | Write window/analytic SQL — ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, NTILE, LAG/LEAD, FIRST_VALUE/LAST_VALUE, running totals, moving averages and frame clauses (ROWS/RANGE). | `sql_sandbox.py` |
